entities.summary: Al-Azhar University, a political institution in Egypt during Roman, Byzantine, and Islamic Egypt (969–1171). Grew from Abbasid and Arab Conquest and Islamic Egypt. Led to the emergence of Fatimid Dynasty and Cairo and Mamluk Sultanate.
